children.name: Gerrardina eylesiana Milne-Redh.
children.description: The native range of this species is Tanzania to S. Trop. Africa. It is a scrambling shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Gerrardina foliosa Oliv.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Africa. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
